title: Rename chat:cap type names to urn:ietf:params:jmap
description:
SCOPE REPLACED 2026-10-20: the urn:jmap:* capability move is REVERTED by spec 42c244b and must NOT be done; capability constants already match. Only the 4 CHAT_CAP_* MessageAction/Endpoint type names move urn:jmap:chat:cap:* -> urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:*. Clean break, no alias (pending Mark confirmation).

Oracle: jmap-chat-spec 6bcd9d8 (quoted text). Mapped by wf_6712c4f8-c2b.

[chat-core] Rename Endpoint/MessageAction type constants to urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:*
Spec (42c244b): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L379-385: "`"urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:vtc"` — video/voice teleconference ... `"urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:calendar-event"` ... `"urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:availability"` ... `"urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:task"` ..."; L387: "Names under the `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:` prefix, which is reserved by a placeholder registration in the \"JMAP Capabilities\" registry ({{iana-capability}}), are assigned only by Standards Track RFCs"; L1866-1871 ABNF: "chat-cap-urn = \"urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:\" 1*cap-char"
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:89 CHAT_CAP_VTC = "urn:jmap:chat:cap:vtc"; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:94 CHAT_CAP_CALENDAR_EVENT; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:99 CHAT_CAP_AVAILABILITY; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:104 CHAT_CAP_TASK; crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/deliver.rs:953 (action.action_type != CHAT_CAP_TASK gates inbound assignee check); crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/outbound.rs:165 (task_assignee_ids gate, used by deliver.rs:829-832 inbound mapping and outbound mapping); crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/jmap_uri.rs:1,124-131 (oracle asserts old values); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/contact.rs:11-13,23-26 (Endpoint docs); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/calendars.rs:44,74; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/tasks.rs:91 (docs); crate-jmap-chat-client/src/calendars.rs:1 (doc); crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/outbound.rs:120,159; crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/deliver.rs:300,821,948 (docs); fixtures: crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/chat_calendars.rs:138,196,201; crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/chat_tasks.rs:162,167; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/message_encrypted_body_types.rs:73; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/message_create_optionals.rs:81,219; crate-jmap-chat-client/src/session.rs:747,764,804,805,828,840; crate-jmap-chat-client/tests/message_smoke_tests.rs:1474; crate-jmap-testjig/tests/chat_client_wire.rs:441; crate-jmap-chat-federation-types/src/session.rs:104; crate-jmap-chat-federation-types/tests/session.rs:213,214,239,255; crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/tests/peer_deliver.rs:606,647; crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/tests/outbound.rs:262
Now: All four CHAT_CAP_* constants are urn:jmap:chat:cap:*. Federation compares action_type to CHAT_CAP_TASK, so a conformant peer's `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:task` action skips assignee identity<->local-id mapping in both directions and skips the deliver.rs:951 assignee validation; our clients/servers emit type names conformant peers ignore as unrecognized.
Change: Set the four constants to urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:{vtc,calendar-event,availability,task}. Update the docs (Endpoint docs may also note the Standards-Track-only prefix reservation, L387) and the fixtures/oracles listed (oracle follows changed spec text). No transitional alias needed (pre-0.4). Adding CHAT_CAP_PAYMENT/BLOB/FILENODE constants is optional; no code needs them. CHANGELOG BREAKING.

[chat-ext] MessageAction/Endpoint type constants still use urn:jmap:chat:cap:*
Spec (42c244b): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-tasks-00.md L179: "A Task ({{JMAP-TASKS}}) MAY be referenced from a chat message via the `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:task` MessageAction type"; L186: ": `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:task`."; draft-atwood-jmap-chat-calendars-00.md L153: "via the `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:calendar-event` MessageAction type"; L250: "When `type` is `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:availability`:" (core definition: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L380-386)
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:89 CHAT_CAP_VTC; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:94 CHAT_CAP_CALENDAR_EVENT; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:99 CHAT_CAP_AVAILABILITY; crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:104 CHAT_CAP_TASK; crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/outbound.rs:164-167 task_assignee_ids compares action_type to CHAT_CAP_TASK; crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/deliver.rs:825-838 (inbound assignee mapping via task_assignee_ids); docs: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/contact.rs:11-26, calendars.rs:44,74, tasks.rs:91; crate-jmap-chat-client/src/calendars.rs:1; crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/src/deliver.rs:300,821,948, outbound.rs:120,159; crate-jmap-chat-federation-types/src/session.rs:104; tests (oracle follows spec text): crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/jmap_uri.rs:124-131, chat_calendars.rs:138,196,201, chat_tasks.rs:162,167; crate-jmap-chat-federation-server/tests/peer_deliver.rs:606,647, outbound.rs:262; crate-jmap-chat-federation-types/tests/session.rs:213-255; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/message_create_optionals.rs:81,219, message_encrypted_body_types.rs:73; crate-jmap-chat-client/src/session.rs:747-840, tests/message_smoke_tests.rs:1474; crate-jmap-testjig/tests/chat_client_wire.rs:441
Now: CHAT_CAP_TASK etc. are "urn:jmap:chat:cap:*". A spec-conformant peer sends "urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:task", so task_assignee_ids returns None and assigneeIds identity strings get stored unmapped (and outbound local ids are sent unmapped). Clients matching these constants never recognise conformant actions or endpoints.
Change: Set the four constants to "urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:{vtc,calendar-event,availability,task}". Update the doc comments listing payment/blob/filenode type names. Update test fixtures and oracles to the new draft text. Add a CHANGELOG wire-break entry. This may overlap with the chat-core review, because chat-00 owns the vocabulary.

[vtc] Rename CHAT_CAP_VTC to urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:vtc
Spec (42c244b): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md L168: "The existing `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:vtc` Endpoint and MessageAction type URIs defined in {{JMAP-CHAT}} provide the integration point in the other direction"; L1679: "carrying a MessageAction of type `\"urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:vtc\"` with the `joinUri`". Defining text: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L380: "`\"urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:vtc\"` — video/voice teleconference."; L388: "Names under the `urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:` prefix, which is reserved by a placeholder registration in the \"JMAP Capabilities\" registry ..., are assigned only by Standards Track RFCs"
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/vocabulary.rs:89 (pub const CHAT_CAP_VTC = "urn:jmap:chat:cap:vtc"); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/contact.rs:11-26 (Endpoint docs list urn:jmap:chat:cap:*); crate-jmap-chat-types/tests/jmap_uri.rs:1,124-131 (asserts old value; oracle text must be re-quoted from chat-00 L380); crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/message_create_optionals.rs:81,219; crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/message_encrypted_body_types.rs:73; crate-jmap-chat-client/src/session.rs:747,764,804-805; crate-jmap-chat-client/tests/message_smoke_tests.rs:1474; crate-jmap-chat-federation-types/src/session.rs:104 (doc example); crate-jmap-chat-federation-types/tests/session.rs:213,239,255; crate-jmap-testjig/tests/chat_client_wire.rs:441
Now: CHAT_CAP_VTC and every fixture or doc use urn:jmap:chat:cap:vtc. At 63e9d08 that matched the spec, so the earlier pass filed nothing. 42c244b moved the type name back under urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:. No VTC crate (vtc-types, vtc-server, chat-vtc-server, scene-vtc-server, wip/vtc-client) references the constant, so the VTC crates themselves need no edit.
Change: Set CHAT_CAP_VTC to "urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:cap:vtc". Update the contact.rs docs and the fixtures and doc examples listed, quoting chat-00 L380 as the oracle. The sibling constants CHAT_CAP_CALENDAR_EVENT, CHAT_CAP_AVAILABILITY and CHAT_CAP_TASK (vocabulary.rs:94,99,104) and the payment/blob/filenode docs need the same change, but chat-00 and the chat extension drafts own those, not the VTC drafts.
